staticPath.entry: Only the accepted extra call for normalized index 19 or 20 supplies r5 = 2 after its separate city-update condition. Helper bit-zero test skips the five direct mode-one branches; bit-one test at 0x82D1719C enters the longer tail at 0x82D171A8.
staticPath.join: The generated helper body identifies a terminal join at 0x82D17760, but the intermediate paths and any bypasses are not completely classified in this packet.
staticPath.selectedPlayerSubpath: At 0x82D171F0, one intermediate path requires source-city player r21 to equal a player value read from a context-selected object, or -1 when its pointer is absent. It calls receiver 0x8314F76C through virtual slot +0x1C0 with r4 = 9 at 0x82D1720C, then at 0x82D17220 through 0x82D1723C sets a zero unsigned halfword to one or increments a nonzero halfword at 0x830EF348 + 2*normalizedIndex. For indices 19 and 20 these cells are 0x830EF36E and 0x830EF370. It then calls the same receiver through slot +0xD0 at 0x82D17250. Initialized vtable 0x82138768 points those slots to 0x82D7CFE8 and 0x82D84560, but this is not a runtime vptr observation.
staticPath.commonClears: At 0x82D17770, the terminal block stores word 0x82FFE7C0 with bit 0x00000400 cleared. At 0x82D1777C it stores city[cityIndex] word +0x24 with bit 0x00008000 cleared.
staticPath.specialWrite: The index-18 branch diverts through other work. At 0x82D17808 and 0x82D17810 the terminal block tests normalized indices 20 and 19; either reaches 0x82D17818 through 0x82D17820, which ORs 0x00010000 into word 0x82FFE7C4. The lis 0x8300 at 0x82D171EC and signed displacement -0x183C form that exact address.
staticPath.qualification: The call is conditional before helper entry. The indexed halfword update requires a further player comparison; its field meaning is unresolved. Terminal writes are exact static facts after that join is reached, not proof of cultural or economic victory, successful completion, or a runtime observation.

currentEvidence.qualification: The main helper decompiler truncates. Current-image words establish the local instructions; the long intermediate tail's dataflow is not promoted from generated code alone. The exact-base queries found no split-constant materializers but do not alter the bounded displacement cohort or identify a bit-specific consumer. No exact entry references or aligned raw direct calls to the snapshot-copy functions were found; indirect dispatch and output-buffer provenance remain unresolved.

Do not treat the bounded displacement cohort as a complete access inventory or a bit-specific consumer proof.

Do not equate stored victory descriptions with implemented or observed outcomes.
conclusion: The conditional mode-two item-219 or item-220 helper path can reach a terminal block that clears two state bits and sets bit 0x10000 in shared status word 0x82FFE7C4. Follow-up scans found no decoded split-constant materializer for either the status-word base or indexed halfword table base. Three whole-word snapshot functions copy the status word to parameter offset +0x200, but have no exact recorded function references or aligned raw direct calls in initialized executable memory below the 32-match cap, and their output-buffer provenance remains unresolved. The intermediate tail, indirect snapshot callers, bit-specific consumer, indexed-halfword meaning, victory interpretation, and runtime outcome remain unresolved.
